text:
ana: Quick sync — for this sprint handoff we need a focused traffic-sampling + profiling pass before the full soak. Goal: run k6/Locust at ~75% of last-week peak for 90m on staging on Tue 08:00 UTC, capture 5-min flamegraphs for hot endpoints, and produce a short regression diff vs last sprint. Who can own: replay dataset, scrubber, replay job, profiling runs, and the post-run analysis?

devin: I can own the replay job creation + scheduling. Which S3 prefix should I use and do we need to strip PII?

ana: use s3://redwood-load/replays/2026-03-sprint-sample. Yes scrub PII. Use the scrubber script we used last month — it strips user ids/email and replaces with hashed ids. I'll paste the scrubber command here.

ana: ```bash
python tools/scrub_replay.py --input s3://raw-replays/2026-02 --output s3://redwood-load/replays/2026-03-sprint-sample --rules rules/scrub.json
```

devin: perfect. I'll kick off a dry-run tomorrow and upload the manifest to the bucket. Will tag the manifest with replay-manifest.json in the same prefix.

mike: I can run profiling. Plan: use py-spy for python services (50Hz sampling) + perf/map collection for the runtime binary. Need an image with debug symbols (perf.map) — can platform build that or do we temp enable symbols on staging?

ana: prefer a temporary perf-enabled image for the profiling run (so we don't affect long-term builds). ops infra can create an AMI with symbols. Also: use 50Hz py-spy to keep overhead low. We'll capture three 5-min windows: warmup (20m in), mid-run (45m), and end (85m).

jen: note: please set header X-Redwood-Cache: no-store for replay traffic so we exercise backend not cache. Also for endpoints that hit KV heavily, tag them in the manifest so we can correlate kv-hit rate with latency.

sid: small ask — there's a CR #4321 open that touches request batching. Can someone review? If that lands pre-soak it might change perf numbers slightly. Ping @eng-runtime reviewers.

ana: good catch. @sid I'll flag it in the rollout plan. If CR lands, we'll run a single short comparison job to see delta before the big soak.

replay-bot: replay job created: id=rb-20260301-07, manifest=s3://redwood-load/replays/2026-03-sprint-sample/replay-manifest.json, scheduled=2026-03-02T08:00:00Z

devin: thanks bot. I'll attach the k6 entry we will run. Basic template below — we'll parameterize vus/duration on the job.

devin: ```bash
k6 run --out json=out.json --vus 450 --duration 90m scripts/staging_replay.js
# or locust: locust -f locustfile.py --headless -u 300 -t 90m --csv=out
```

mike: for profiling agents, I'll run py-spy record on the process pid like: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid $PID --rate 50` and capture perf.data via `perf record -F 99 -p $PID -g -- sleep 300`. Will push artifacts to s3://redwood-load/profiles/2026-03-02/.

jen: I'll own dashboarding and latency heatmaps. After the run please drop a minimal CSV: endpoint, p50, p95, p99, kv_hit_rate, error_rate. I'll produce a diff vs baseline.

mike: one more: can we get a copy of last-sprint baseline artifacts location?

ana: baseline is s3://redwood-load/baselines/2026-02-sprint. Use that for comparisons.

sid: CR reviewers — bumping the PR in the channel: @maria @kai can you take a look today? It's small: batching tweak and a new toggle.

maria: will review tonight, if it's green i'll aim to merge before Tue if nothing else blocks.

ana: owners summary: devin=replay job + manifest, mike=profiling & artifact upload, jen=dashboards/diff, sid=CR coordination, ana (me)=scrubber + schedule + final checklist. I'll post the run checklist (preflight items, smoke tests, rollbacks) in the morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:

devin: tagging the replay manifest when dryrun passes.

replay-bot: dry-run completed: id=rb-20260301-07-dry, checks=ok, sample_coverage=78%, estimated_vus=440

ana: looks good. If any blockers surface call out here or DM. We'll capture flamegraphs and a short 1-page summary of regressions within 24h post-run.

jen: noted. I'll stand by to consume csvs and produce the report.

sid: thanks, will follow up on CR.

mike: prepping profiler nodes now.

ana: end-of-thread: I'll post final checklist with explicit times and rollback steps by 2026-03-01 16:00 UTC.
